final_claim: For complete strict stable marriage, minimum-regret and sex-equal optimum sets coincide for every two-pair profile; over the 46656 labeled three-pair profiles the exact relation counts are 38880 equal, 7488 with the sex-equal set strictly contained in the minimum-regret set, 144 with the reverse strict containment and 144 disjoint, and the disjoint profiles form exactly two natural symmetry orbits of size 72.
limitations: Complete strict balanced stable marriage through three pairs only.
